blocks.content:
### 📌 Top 10 Highest-Yield Exam Items (Rapid Revision Master List)

1. **RBI Monetary Policy (3rd Bi-Monthly FY27):** Repo rate maintained at **5.25%** (neutral stance); FY27 Real GDP growth projected at **6.7%**; CPI inflation projected at **5.0%**.
2. **RBI Basel III Pillar 3 Deferral:** Disclosures deferred from 30 Sep 2026 ➔ **1 April 2027**; Tata Sons classified under NBFC-Upper Layer (17 total entities).
3. **D-SIB Additional CET1 Surcharge:** SBI (**0.80%**), HDFC Bank (**0.40%**), ICICI Bank (**0.20%**).
4. **Vande Mataram Bill Enactment:** Passed by Parliament and received Presidential Assent on **11 August 2026**.
5. **Flagship Scheme Outlays:** Samudra Manthan (**₹84,084 Cr**), GOBARdhan (**₹23,731 Cr**), PM-KISAN cumulative transfer (**₹3,15,614 Cr**).
6. **Superlative Firsts:** India’s Ramsar network reached **101 sites** (Glaw Lake, Arunachal Pradesh); UPI monthly volume touched **23.66 Billion transactions (₹29.88 Lakh Cr)**.
7. **80th Independence Day ‘Sapt Dhara’:** 7 national pillars; 1 Crore AI-skilling target; 100 GW nuclear capacity target by 2047.
8. **Banking Health & Economy:** India nominal GDP at **$3.92 Trillion (6th largest)**; PSB GNPA dropped to **1.93%**; LIC OFS floor price at ₹382.
9. **Leadership Firsts:** **Varsha Aglawe** (1st woman Director General of Geological Survey of India); **Wg Cdr Bhawana Kanth** (1st woman Fighter Combat Leader graduate).
10. **Sports Firsts:** Commonwealth Games 2026 Glasgow (India 4th with 39 medals); Tanvi Sharma wins Taipei Open (first Indian woman since Saina Nehwal in 2008).
